moments.title: European Athletics Championships conclude
moments.blurb: The European Athletics Championships, held in Birmingham for the first time, conclude tomorrow, Sunday 16 August, after a week of world-class track and field action.

angles.name: Final Day Excitement
angles.copy: It's the penultimate day for the European Athletics Championships in Birmingham! Who are you backing for gold before tomorrow's grand finale? #EuroAthletics2026

angles.name: Birmingham Hosts
angles.copy: History made in Birmingham! The UK's first ever European Athletics Championships wraps up this weekend. What's been your highlight so far?

moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament culminates tomorrow, Sunday 16 August, with both the men's and women's finals taking place at Lord's Cricket Ground.

angles.name: Cricket Showdown
angles.copy: It's Finals Day for The Hundred tomorrow! Who will be crowned champions at Lord's? Get ready for a day of explosive cricket!

angles.name: Welsh Fire Pride
angles.copy: Were you backing Welsh Fire in The Hundred this season? The finals are tomorrow – what a tournament it's been!

moments.title: Premier League season begins
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season kicks off next Friday, August 21st, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: Football's Back
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! The Premier League returns next Friday, August 21st. Who's going to hit the ground running this season?

angles.name: Season Predictions
angles.copy: Only 6 days until the Premier League kicks off! What are your bold predictions for the new season? Top 4? Relegation? Golden Boot?

moments.title: All Points East Festival starts
moments.blurb: London's All Points East festival begins next Friday, August 21st, running over two weekends with headliners including Lorde, Deftones, and Tyler, The Creator.

angles.name: London Festival Vibes
angles.copy: All Points East kicks off next Friday in Victoria Park! Who are you most excited to see – Lorde, Deftones, Tyler, The Creator, or someone else on the massive line-up?

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Just one week until All Points East takes over London! Get ready for 10 days of incredible music and festival atmosphere.

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals approaching
moments.blurb: The twin Reading & Leeds Festivals take place from Thursday 27 August to Sunday 30 August, featuring headliners like Charli XCX, Chase and Status, Dave, Florence and the Machine, Fontaines DC, and Raye.

angles.name: Bank Holiday Festivals
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds Festivals are just around the corner, kicking off on August 27th! Who's ready for the biggest bank holiday weekend in music?

angles.name: Leeds Local Buzz
angles.copy: Leeds Festival is nearly here! Bramham Park will be buzzing with Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine and more. Who are you hoping to catch?

moments.title: Creamfields Festival approaching
moments.blurb: The UK's largest electronic music festival, Creamfields, takes place from August 27-30 in Cheshire, with headliners including Calvin Harris, Swedish House Mafia, Tiësto, and Disclosure.

angles.name: Dance Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Creamfields is just under two weeks away! Who's ready to hit Daresbury for Calvin Harris, Swedish House Mafia, Tiësto and more?

angles.name: Electronic Music Extravaganza
angles.copy: Planning your Creamfields weekend? With Disclosure, Underworld and Amelie Lens all playing, it's going to be huge!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at Number 1 on the Official UK Singles Chart for the week of August 14, making it 21 non-consecutive weeks at the top.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: Still reigning! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is Number 1 on the Official UK Singles Chart again! An incredible 21 non-consecutive weeks at the top.

angles.name: Sam Fender Dominance
angles.copy: Is 'Rein Me In' the song of the year? Sam Fender and Olivia Dean continue their chart dominance. What's your favourite lyric?

moments.title: Madonna & Kylie Minogue chart success
moments.blurb: Madonna and Kylie Minogue's collaboration 'Love Sensation' debuted at Number 8 on the Official UK Singles Chart this week, marking Madonna's 65th and Kylie's 37th Top 10 single.

angles.name: Pop Royalty Team Up
angles.copy: Legends unite! Madonna and Kylie Minogue's 'Love Sensation' just entered the Top 10 of the UK Singles Chart. What a collaboration!

angles.name: Chart Records
angles.copy: 65 Top 10s for Madonna, 37 for Kylie! Their new track 'Love Sensation' is a certified hit. Which of their classic collabs is your favourite?

moments.title: Phoebe Bridgers turns 32 with new album
moments.blurb: Acclaimed singer-songwriter Phoebe Bridgers turns 32 on August 17, just days after releasing her anticipated third solo album, 'Lost Weekend', on August 14.

angles.name: Birthday & New Music
angles.copy: Happy birthday to Phoebe Bridgers, who turns 32 on Monday! Her new album 'Lost Weekend' just dropped. What's your favourite track so far?

angles.name: Indie Icon
angles.copy: A huge week for Phoebe Bridgers! Celebrate her 32nd birthday on Monday by diving into her incredible new record.

moments.title: Madonna turns 68
moments.blurb: The Queen of Pop, Madonna, celebrates her 68th birthday tomorrow, Sunday 16 August.

angles.name: Queen of Pop's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to the one and only Madonna tomorrow! What's your all-time favourite track from the Material Girl?

angles.name: Madonna's Legacy
angles.copy: From 'Like A Virgin' to 'Love Sensation', Madonna has defined pop for decades. Celebrate her 68th birthday tomorrow by listening to a legend.

moments.title: Belinda Carlisle turns 68
moments.blurb: Former Go-Go's frontwoman and 'Heaven Is a Place on Earth' singer Belinda Carlisle celebrates her 68th birthday on Monday, August 17.

angles.name: 80s Pop Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to the incredible Belinda Carlisle on Monday! What's your favourite Go-Go's hit or solo classic?

angles.name: Heavenly Hits
angles.copy: Still dreaming of 'Heaven Is a Place on Earth'? Celebrate Belinda Carlisle's 68th birthday this Monday with her timeless tracks.

moments.title: MC Eric (Technotronic) turns 58
moments.blurb: Cardiff-born rapper MC Eric, known for his work with 90s dance group Technotronic on hits like 'Pump Up the Jam', celebrates his 58th birthday on Tuesday, August 18.

angles.name: Welsh 90s Dance Legend
angles.copy: Pump up the jam! Happy 58th birthday on Tuesday to Cardiff's own MC Eric, the voice behind Technotronic's biggest hits.

angles.name: Technotronic Throwback
angles.copy: Remember Technotronic's 'Pump Up the Jam'? Shout out to Cardiff-born MC Eric, celebrating his 58th birthday this Tuesday!
